name: giventake-devs
description: GivenTake Devs, a web studio in Northeast Ohio building custom websites for small businesses from $999. One public tool: request a free five-minute recorded site check for a small-business website.

tools.name: request_site_check
tools.description: Request a free five-minute recorded review of a small-business website. A person records it and emails it back. Requires the person's name, email address, the site URL, and their consent to be emailed.
